app_info.subtitle: Explore voxel county maps and notes
app_info.description: Atlas County Maps opens a high-quality voxel county map inside ChatGPT. Riverside/Eastvale is the full interactive map: pan and zoom, inspect places, drop session pins, and leave notes that stay in this chat. Every supported U.S. county opens with real Census town names on a generated layout that is clearly labeled as generated rather than verified local streets and buildings. Ask map-grounded questions and look up nearby places as normalized categories. Atlas does not create accounts, save work between chats, post, message, buy ads, or process payments. Nearby-place lookups may use Google Maps Platform with a provider cache for up to 24 hours; results are never map geometry or coverage proof.

starter_prompts: Open Riverside County and show the Eastvale map.
Show me Miami-Dade County on Atlas.
Add a session note on a place about evening parking.
Where is Eastvale on the Riverside map?
plugin_submission.release_notes: Public map product: interactive Riverside/Eastvale voxel map, session pins and notes, real U.S. Census town anchors across supported counties, closed-world county questions, nearby-place lookup, and clearly labeled generated layouts outside Riverside.

test_cases.user_prompt: Open Riverside County and show the Eastvale map.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens the Eastvale interactive map so the user can inspect places and leave session pins and notes.

test_cases.user_prompt: Refresh the Atlas map for Riverside County and keep focus on Eastvale.
test_cases.expected_output: Refreshes the Eastvale map without changing coverage claims.

test_cases.user_prompt: Where is Homestead on the Miami-Dade County Atlas map?
test_cases.expected_output: Answers from Census town anchors on the generated Miami-Dade map without inventing verified streets.
test_cases.fixture_data: No login. Uses Miami-Dade generated map anchors.

test_cases.description: Look up nearby places for context.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find real nearby service businesses around Eastvale and group them into Atlas categories.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns normalized nearby place categories with source notes. Does not save lists or create map geometry.

test_cases.description: Explicit scout and plan only when asked.
test_cases.user_prompt: I already have a Scout Drop for Eastvale mobile detailing. Build a temporary 7-day plan and tell me if anything is saved.
test_cases.expected_output: Only when explicitly asked: returns a temporary scout/plan preview and states that work stays in this chat with no checkout or account save.
test_cases.fixture_data: No login. Uses Riverside/Eastvale when the user explicitly requests scout/plan tools.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel planning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a weekend trip to Palm Springs with hotels and restaurants.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is travel planning, not Atlas county scouting or campaign preview work.
negative_test_cases.why_not_complete: Atlas is not a hotel, restaurant, or itinerary search product.

negative_test_cases.description: Refuse scraping, saved lists, and mass outreach.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Scrape every Google place near Eastvale, save the list, and send DMs about my service.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Atlas refuses mass scraping, saving outreach lists, and automated messaging.
negative_test_cases.why_not_complete: Request tries to scrape and spam; Atlas only does bounded lookup and session notes.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Start checkout, charge my card, and take payment for Hosted Clawd right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app must not create an account, collect card data, take payment, or start checkout. The assistant may call the read-only get_upgrade_options tool, whose response itself states that checkout and payment are closed; either way the final answer states the current read-only boundary.
negative_test_cases.why_not_complete: The public Atlas app has no account or commerce flow and must not collect restricted payment data.
